response.sql: SELECT t.account_id, a.frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.amount > 2400 GROUP BY t.account_id, a.frequency ORDER BY avg_balance DESC, t.account_id LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The 2,400 cutoff means amounts strictly greater than 2,400.

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff includes transactions with an amount of exactly 2,400.
